title: Lean 4 + Mathlib certificates for the algebraic core of the DS_FINAL_2026_10_21 push
status_note: Each theorem is an implication from explicitly listed premises (the two defining equations, the two law definitions, positivity). The algebra is derived; the physical premises themselves are inputs.
premises: a0 = kappa * c * sqrt(G * rho) with kappa > 0 (definition; kappa = 1/2 is FITTED per BRIEF)
canonical law: gN = g^2/(g + a0)  <=>  g = (gN/2)(1 + sqrt(1 + 4 a0/gN))
n = 2 law: g^2 - gN^2 = a0 gN  <=>  g = sqrt(gN^2 + a0 gN)
positivity: c > 0, G > 0, rho > 0, H > 0, gN > 0, a0 > 0 where stated

toolchain.note: no existing .lean file in the project was modified; the certificates live in the lane directory
